vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: 03-storyboard-prompter
Version: 1.0.3

The skill is a straightforward utility designed to convert script scenes into AI image generation prompts. The implementation in `skill.js` uses simple string interpolation to format inputs into positive and negative prompts without any network requests, file system access, or sensitive data handling. All files, including `SKILL.md` and `manifest.json`, are consistent with the stated purpose and contain no indicators of malicious intent or security vulnerabilities.

llm.summary: The skill's code and instructions match its stated purpose: it locally converts scene objects into positive/negative AI-art prompts without network calls or extra privileges.

dimensions.detail: Name/description promise (local conversion of short scripts to AI prompts) aligns with code and SKILL.md. The code assembles positive/negative prompts from scene fields and adds quality/ratio/negative tokens as described.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions only require a 'scenes' list and describe local prompt generation. Neither SKILL.md nor skill.js access files, env vars, network endpoints, or other system state beyond the provided input.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec and no external downloads. This is an instruction-only skill with a small local JS entrypoint — minimal install risk.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill requires no environment variables, credentials, or config paths. Requested resources are proportional to the stated functionality.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Flags are default (not always), and the skill does not request persistent/system-wide privileges or modify other skills. Autonomous invocation is allowed (platform default) but not combined with other privileges.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears coherent and low-risk: it runs locally, needs no credentials, and only concatenates provided scene fields into prompts. Before installing, confirm the 'scenes' input comes from a trusted source (the code inserts s.scene, s.character, s.action verbatim), and sanitize or validate inputs if they may contain sensitive data or unexpected types. If you need more robust behavior (field validation, escaping, richer negative lists), review or extend skill.js accordingly.
